body.prompt: 16-bit pixel art background layer for a 2D side-scrolling action game. Flat straight-on side elevation view, one continuous horizontal panorama spread evenly across the full width, no vignette, no frame, no characters, no creatures, no text, no UI. Distant scenery only, soft atmospheric haze, muted low-contrast colours so foreground sprites stand out, bottom quarter fades into plain dark shadow. Crisp chunky pixels, limited palette, retro console game art. Scene: an underground cavern city built inside old metro tunnels. A long row of crooked shanty towers made of stacked corrugated-metal shacks receding in layered dark silhouettes, tangled pipes and hanging cables along the top, tiny warm sodium lamps and a few small magenta and cyan neon signs. Deep navy darkness.
